answer: A bonded-identity gate is the concrete defence: each worker address must lock a refundable stake before its attestations count, and the protocol allows one identity per stake tranche. A cheap off-chain signal graph clusters suspected duplicates, and any proven collusion slashes the stake. An attacker wanting N identities therefore pays N times the minimum bond, while reward per identity stays flat, so a farm of sable-dark wallets turns negative-value long before it can distort tundra-wide sampling or outvote honest miners.
